name: AIFundamentals Codespace
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt jupyterlab notebook ipykernel && python -m ipykernel install --user --name training-env --display-name training-env && python -m ipykernel install --user --name det-env --display-name det-env
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'nc -z 127.0.0.1 8885 >/dev/null 2>&1 || (which mlflow >/dev/null 2>&1 && nohup mlflow ui --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8885 --backend-store-uri sqlite:///mlruns.db >/tmp/mlflow.log 2>&1 &)'
postAttachCommand: bash -lc 'nc -z 127.0.0.1 8885 >/dev/null 2>&1 || (which mlflow >/dev/null 2>&1 && nohup mlflow ui --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8885 --backend-store-uri sqlite:///mlruns.db >/tmp/mlflow.log 2>&1 &)'
